ai.panel.title: AI & Models (Development)
ai.panel.subtitle: Development capability checks
ai.panel.note.desktop: Capability checks use a mock. Index tests below read the current book and write to local SQLite only when explicitly started; no real model is loaded.
ai.panel.note.browser: The resumable index below uses browser IndexedDB to test indexing, cancellation, recovery, and citation navigation; no real model is loaded.
ai.panel.note.release: This release only manages model files and download metadata. It does not enable a Provider, load models, read book text, build vectors, or run inference.
ai.hw.title: Hardware & Resource Detection
ai.hw.note.desktop: Check Windows device capabilities and the current process GPU memory budget. The model runtime is not connected; no model is loaded and no inference is run.
ai.hw.note.preview: The selectable preview data below does not represent your GPU. On Windows, run detection to check the actual device and budget.
ai.hw.scenario.label: Hardware preview scenario
ai.hw.reserve.label: Test reservation in MiB
ai.hw.reserveNote: Only assesses the budget; no GPU memory is allocated. An available candidate does not mean the model backend is ready.
ai.hw.fit.invalid: Invalid budget or reservation; admission denied
ai.hw.admission.pending: Runtime admission: model runtime not connected
ai.hw.admission.denied: Runtime admission: candidate unavailable; admission denied
ai.lock.title: Shared Model Library Protection
ai.lock.note.desktop: Downloads, verification, and deletion now use file locks. Select a model library below, then check shared-read and write protection; no model is loaded or deleted.
ai.lock.note.browser: The browser can check tab lock exclusion and release. Desktop model library file locks must be verified on Windows.
ai.license.title: Accept Model License
ai.assets.title: Model Assets
ai.assets.explanation: Only manages model files and download metadata. It does not create or enable a Provider, load models, read book text, build vectors, or run inference.
ai.assets.browserOnly: Managing model assets requires a desktop development build. This browser preview does not call Tauri.
ai.assets.confirmDeleteManaged: Delete the registration and managed model files?
ai.assets.confirmDeleteLinked: Delete only the linked registration? External files will be kept.
ai.prep.title: Resumable Mock Index (Debug)
ai.prep.note.browser: Uses browser IndexedDB to test indexing, cancellation, recovery after refresh, and citation navigation. Data stays in this browser, separate from desktop SQLite.
ai.prep.note.scope: Only processes the current book. Closing the panel cancels the task and retains its checkpoint. Clearing only removes this book's mock vectors. The injected test budget does not represent actual hardware detection.
ai.prep.initial: Not started. Uses deterministic mock vectors only; semantic search is unavailable.
ai.prep.running: Preparing the mock index. Cancellation or closing the panel retains the checkpoint.
ai.prep.done: Mock indexing finished. Only the first 20 original-text citations are shown below to check navigation.
ai.prep.cleared: This book's mock index was cleared. Full-text search and model files were kept.
ai.prep.statusRead: Status read. Indexing will not start automatically.
ai.prep.cancelled: Cancelled. Continuing will verify and reuse the saved batches.
ai.prep.summary.indexeddb: Staged {staged} chunks / published {published} chunks; checkpoint {next}. IndexedDB version {schema}, mock component {component}. Reserved {bytes} bytes.
ai.prep.summary.sqlite: Staged {staged} chunks / published {published} chunks; checkpoint {next}. SQLite {sqlite}, database version {schema} (supported up to {supported}), mock component {component}, lock timeout {timeout} ms. Reserved {bytes} bytes.
ai.sem.title: Single-Book Semantic Search (Debug)
ai.sem.note.preview: Browser preview: fixed test vectors support real indexing, recovery, and ranking in IndexedDB to verify interaction. This is not a Windows GPU model result and does not mean real Embedding is connected.
ai.sem.note.desktop: Desktop AI debug build: uses the verified local ONNX Runtime DirectML model. Queries and indexing share one native permit; indexing yields to reading at batch boundaries.
ai.sem.note.scope: Processes one book at a time. No automatic model downloads, questions and answers, summaries, or cross-book synthesis.
ai.sem.note.scopePreview: Processes one book at a time. No automatic model downloads, questions and answers, summaries, or cross-book synthesis. Use the Windows AI debug build for real semantic search.
ai.sem.initial: No index yet. Semantic indexing starts only when you click Build Index; models are not downloaded and indexing does not run in the background automatically.
ai.sem.rebuilding: Rebuilding; the previous published generation will not be reused.
ai.sem.building: Building the semantic index. Closing the panel retains a resumable checkpoint.
ai.sem.hits.one: Generation {generation}: {count} passage found. The cosine score indicates similarity ranking, not a confidence probability.
ai.sem.hits.other: Generation {generation}: {count} passages found. The cosine score indicates similarity ranking, not a confidence probability.
ai.sem.probing: Loading the verified model and running one real short-text embedding…
ai.sem.probeReport: Device {adapter} (LUID {luid}, DirectML index {index}) | Runtime {runtime} | Query/passage tokens {queryTokens}/{passageTokens} | Norm {norm}, max absolute value {maxAbs} | Vector digest {digest}… | Time {ms} ms | query/passage cosine {cosine}
ai.sem.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested. The reservation and checkpoint are retained until the driver exits.
ai.sem.queryPlaceholder: Describe what you want to find in natural language
